      About this item
      Care instructions
      Clean and air dry all tools before storing. Keep in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.

      About this item

      • COMPLETE 16-IN-1 LUXURY SHOE POLISH KIT: Everything for premium leather care in one complete shoe polish kit: Black/Brown/Neutral Shoe Polish (2.1oz/60g each), Saddle Soap (2.1oz), Mink Oil (2.1oz), 3 Horsehair Brushes, 3 Cloths, 2 Towels, 2 Sponges—all in a luxury leather bag. This all-in-one shoe shine kit keeps shoes, boots, and leather goods looking their best at home or on the go—perfect for shoe cleaning and boot polishing.
      • EXCLUSIVE 3-STEP LEATHER CARE: CLEAN CONDITION POLISH: Unlike most shoe shine kits, this set includes saddle soap, mink oil, and shoe polish for a complete 3-step leather care routine. Deep clean with saddle soap, condition with mink oil, then add rich color and lasting shine with shoe wax. This process restores softness, enhances luster, and extends the life of leather shoes and boots.
      • PROFESSIONAL TOOLS FOR EASY MAINTENANCE: The large horsehair brush removes dirt and dust; medium and small brushes apply saddle soap or shoe polish and clean seams or edges. Polishing cloths and towels buff leather to a brilliant shine or wipe away excess oils without scratching, and are washable for repeated use. The sponge applies mink oil effortlessly, while the portable shine sponge is ideal for quick touch-ups when traveling or at the office.
      • PREMIUM QUALITY WITH NATURAL INGREDIENTS: Crafted with high-quality shoe wax in Black, Brown, and Neutral shades, plus natural conditioners like mink oil, beeswax, carnauba wax, and lanolin. These premium ingredients nourish leather, reduce fading, and form a waterproof barrier against dust and daily wear.
      • PERFECT GIFT FOR MEN & WOMEN: Elegantly organized in a high-end leather bag, this all-in-one shoe polish kit is an ideal gift for men, women, fathers, mothers, partners, and friends. Perfect for birthdays, Christmas, anniversaries, and more. Whether for business travel, holidays, or home storage, it keeps tools tidy and ready for use—practical, stylish, and a true expression of care.

      About this Item

      • COMPLETE 16-IN-1 LUXURY SHOE POLISH KIT: Everything for premium leather care in one complete shoe polish kit: Black/Brown/Neutral Shoe Polish (2.1oz/60g each), Saddle Soap (2.1oz), Mink Oil (2.1oz), 3 Horsehair Brushes, 3 Cloths, 2 Towels, 2 Sponges—all in a luxury leather bag. This all-in-one shoe shine kit keeps shoes, boots, and leather goods looking their best at home or on the go—perfect for shoe cleaning and boot polishing.
      • EXCLUSIVE 3-STEP LEATHER CARE: CLEAN CONDITION POLISH: Unlike most shoe shine kits, this set includes saddle soap, mink oil, and shoe polish for a complete 3-step leather care routine. Deep clean with saddle soap, condition with mink oil, then add rich color and lasting shine with shoe wax. This process restores softness, enhances luster, and extends the life of leather shoes and boots.
      • PROFESSIONAL TOOLS FOR EASY MAINTENANCE: The large horsehair brush removes dirt and dust; medium and small brushes apply saddle soap or shoe polish and clean seams or edges. Polishing cloths and towels buff leather to a brilliant shine or wipe away excess oils without scratching, and are washable for repeated use. The sponge applies mink oil effortlessly, while the portable shine sponge is ideal for quick touch-ups when traveling or at the office.
      • PREMIUM QUALITY WITH NATURAL INGREDIENTS: Crafted with high-quality shoe wax in Black, Brown, and Neutral shades, plus natural conditioners like mink oil, beeswax, carnauba wax, and lanolin. These premium ingredients nourish leather, reduce fading, and form a waterproof barrier against dust and daily wear.
      • PERFECT GIFT FOR MEN & WOMEN: Elegantly organized in a high-end leather bag, this all-in-one shoe polish kit is an ideal gift for men, women, fathers, mothers, partners, and friends. Perfect for birthdays, Christmas, anniversaries, and more. Whether for business travel, holidays, or home storage, it keeps tools tidy and ready for use—practical, stylish, and a true expression of care.

      Product description

      The FEILOVE 16-in-1 Luxury Shoe Polish Kit offers complete leather care in one set. Includes Black, Brown, and Neutral Shoe Wax (2.1oz each), Saddle Soap (2.1oz), Mink Oil (2.1oz), 3 Horsehair Brushes, 3 Cloths, 2 Towels, and 2 Sponges, all stored in a high-end leather bag. Our 3-step care system—Clean, Condition, Polish—deep cleans with saddle soap, nourishes with mink oil, and adds rich color, lasting shine, and a waterproof barrier with shoe wax. Premium natural ingredients like mink oil, beeswax, carnauba wax, and lanolin help protect against dust, moisture, and wear. Perfect for shoes, boots, and leather goods at home or on the go, and an ideal gift for men and women for birthdays, Christmas, and more.
